raw:
“I remember feeling sad when my father missed my school play. His train was delayed by snow, so he couldn’t get there. I’d saved a program for him, and I’d really been looking forward to him seeing the play.

I knew the delay wasn’t his fault, but I was still disappointed. I wanted him to be there, to see what I’d been doing. The program stands out in my memory because I’d put it aside especially for him. It was such a small thing, but looking at it reminded me that he hadn’t been there. Knowing why he missed it didn’t quite take away the sadness.”
